description: **Provider-agnostic rolling compaction** adds `auto`, `rolling`, and `full_replace` strategies, fixed/dynamic triggers, configurable band count and compaction routes, CAS-safe history replacement, and TUI status/settings.

**Anthropic peer provider (API key)** is documented end-to-end: `/providers` + `grok provider set-key anthropic --from-env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, Models cache, model picker, repository-owned Messages client, Files as library-only (mock-tested; product surface deferred), and custom Messages / OpenRouter separation.
**Migration guide** for existing custom Messages configs (non-destructive; no automatic secret migration).

**Claude Agent CLI** remains experimental and gated (`claude-cli-runtime` off in default/`release-dist`; `GROK_CLAUDE_CLI_RUNTIME` + binary probe). Ordinary release builds hide the subscription card. Release enablement pending authorization.
Docs avoid Anthropic literal keys in TOML/`extra_headers`. Rollout audit tests lock feature gates, catalog visibility, envelope redaction, and OpenRouter privacy defaults coexistence.
